{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Verify the conversion status column
print("Column names:", sales_df.columns.tolist())
print("Unique values in 'converted':", sales_df['converted'].unique())
print("Value counts in 'converted':", sales_df['converted'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Extract the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates.index[0]

# Confirm it's a valid segment
print("Highest conversion rate segment:", highest_segment)
print("Conversion rate:", conversion_rates.iloc[0])

# Return the result
highest_segment"}
